intent.exercises: an end-to-end valid plan: short compositions that fit the 255 m gateway, and arrivals spaced widely enough that no train has to stand on it
notes: Train unit types are restricted to the four shortest (SGMM-2 52.2 m, SNG-3 59.5 m, FFF-3 63.2 m, SLT-4 69.4 m). With units_per_composition [1,2] the longest possible train is 138.7 m, well inside the 255 m gateway track 906a, so this config can never fail the way random_distribution1/2 and larger-example do.

min_gap_on_gateway is 900 s against a ~300-450 s move off the gateway. The slack is deliberate: it keeps arrivals far enough apart that no train has to stand on 906a waiting for its route into the yard, which Robust-Rail-NL/robust-rail-solver#13 would still reject because the gateway forbids parking. Tightening it is what makes the fixture harder, so it is the first knob to turn once #13 is fixed.

Measured 19/20 feasible over seeds 1-20; see docs/scenario-feasibility.md. The one failure is a departure-time mismatch, not a length or capacity problem: the evaluator requires an Exit to happen at exactly the scheduled departure time.
